content.comment_body: I have a [product_name] with article number [article_no] and firmware version [version_no]. Is it possible to upgrade this model to the latest firmware? I downloaded the new firmware from the [company_name] website, extracted the files, and placed up_bm.bin on a blank 32GB SD card. When I insert the card and power on the device, nothing happens. Assuming the update is compatible, I thought it should start updating automatically, but it doesn't. The device has been reset to factory settings and is in STOP mode. Is there a maximum firmware version compatible with this hardware or a limit on SD card size? Or is it simply not upgradeable? Thanks for any assistance.
No. Devices with firmware FS01-FS03 ([version_no]) cannot be upgraded. Only units with FS04 or FS05 ([version_no]) can be updated to FS06 ([version_no]).
Thank you for the quick response and for clarifying my concerns about the firmware upgrade.
